installation.script:
#!/bin/ash

apk add --no-cache curl

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server
fi

cd /mnt/server

# Adding '.jar' if it isn't part of the file name
if [ "${SERVER_JARFILE##*.}" != "jar" ]; then
    echo "adding .jar to server file name"
    SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE}.jar"
fi

if [ -z "${WATERDOG_VERSION}" ] || [ "${WATERDOG_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    echo "downloading latest waterdog pe release"
    curl -sSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" https://github.com/WaterdogPE/WaterdogPE/releases/download/latest/Waterdog.jar
else 
    echo "downloading waterdog pe version ${WATERDOG_VERSION}"
    curl -sSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "https://github.com/WaterdogPE/WaterdogPE/releases/download/${WATERDOG_VERSION}/Waterdog.jar"
fi

if [ ! -f config.yml ]; then
    echo "Downloading waterdog pe config.yml"
    curl -sSL -o config.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/game_eggs/minecraft/proxy/bedrock/waterdog_pe/config.yml
else
    echo "Waterdog config.yml exists. Will not pull a new file"
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
